description: This file defines the interface for Android's AIBinder object used for inter-process communication (IPC). It includes type definitions, function prototypes, and documentation for managing binder objects, including creation, transaction, death notifications, and class association.

classes.name: AIBinder
classes.description: Represents a local or remote binder object used for IPC, with functions for transaction management, lifecycle, and class association.

classes.name: AIBinder_Weak
classes.description: Weak reference to an AIBinder object, allowing promotion to strong reference.

classes.name: AIBinder_DeathRecipient
classes.description: Callback object for death notifications of binder objects.

classes.name: AIBinder_Class
classes.description: Defines a class of binder objects with specific transaction handling and creation routines.

methods.name: AIBinder_new
methods.description: Creates a new binder object of a specified class.

methods.name: AIBinder_transact
methods.description: Performs a transaction on the binder object with specified input and output parcels.

methods.name: AIBinder_linkToDeath
methods.description: Registers a death recipient to be notified if the binder dies.

methods.name: AIBinder_unlinkToDeath
methods.description: Unregisters a death recipient from the binder.

methods.name: AIBinder_isRemote
methods.description: Checks if the binder object is in a remote process.

methods.name: AIBinder_isAlive
methods.description: Checks if the binder object is known to be alive.

methods.name: AIBinder_ping
methods.description: Sends a ping transaction to verify if the binder is responsive.

methods.name: AIBinder_getCallingUid
methods.description: Returns the UID of the caller in a transaction.

methods.name: AIBinder_getCallingPid
methods.description: Returns the PID of the caller in a transaction.

methods.name: AIBinder_incStrong
methods.description: Increments the strong reference count of the binder.

methods.name: AIBinder_decStrong
methods.description: Decrements the strong reference count, potentially destroying the binder.

methods.name: AIBinder_getExtension
methods.description: Retrieves the extension object associated with the binder.

methods.name: AIBinder_setExtension
methods.description: Sets an extension object for the binder.

methods.name: AIBinder_Class_define
methods.description: Defines a new binder class with creation, destruction, and transaction routines.
